newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: SOFT NZ DLR SEES SHORT RATES SPIKE TO HIGHER CLOSE.
newsitem.headline: SOFT NZ DLR SEES SHORT RATES SPIKE TO HIGHER CLOSE.

text.p: Figures in brackets compare against previous day's close
OVERNIGHT CASH 8.15 PCT (PREV 8.10) US 5-YR 6.13 (PREV 6.10) NZD/USD 0.6357/64 (PREV 0.6404/11) US 10-YR 6.26 (PREV 6.22)
RBNZ MCI NZ/MCI 732.20 (PREV 741.96) Reuters NZ MCI -93 vs -83
* NZ bills sold at close as NZD falls to new 29 mth low
* Mid bonds outperform short and long ends of curve
* Yields seen rising further into next week
New Zealand's money market ended the week on a bearish note on Friday, suffering at the hands of a falling currency.
The key 90-day bank bills spiked to a close of 8.45 percent, up 17 basis points from Thursday's finish, as the kiwi dollar dropped to a fresh 29-month low of US$0.6346.
